_meta.source: Cisco UCS Server BIOS Tokens guides (public PDFs fetched via WebFetch, text via pdftotext -layout, layout-parsed by script): Release 4.3 (b-ucs-bios-tokens-guide-4_3.pdf, updated 2025-07-07; X210c M7 table in 4.3(2b) section), Release 6.0 (m-ucs-server-bios-tokens.pdf), Release 4.2 (b_UCS_BIOS_Tokens_Guide_chapter_01.pdf), Release 4.1 (b_UCS_BIOS_Tokens_Guide_4_1.pdf)
_meta.status: unverified (single doc series, layout-parsed). Rows with needs_review=true have PDF column-overflow damage; raw_cells kept. xml_attr_candidate is a name-similarity guess, NOT a verified GUI->XML mapping.
_meta.note: These are UCSM GUI token names (not XML vp* names). Authoritative XML names/enums are in bios_attributes.json.
